name: Jakkafawn
dex: Born each March when the jacaranda trees bloom. It naps under purple canopies on quiet streets.
ref: Bengaluru's jacaranda trees, which turn whole avenues purple every March.

name: Jakkadeer
dex: Its antlers flower year-round. Petals it sheds are said to cool the hottest summer pavements.
ref: Bengaluru's jacaranda trees, which turn whole avenues purple every March.

name: Jakkaranda
dex: When it walks the avenues at dawn, every jacaranda it passes bursts into bloom.
ref: Bengaluru's jacaranda trees, which turn whole avenues purple every March.

name: Kaapup
dex: The steel tumbler on its head is always warm. It follows the smell of fresh decoction for miles.
ref: Filter coffee, poured between a steel tumbler and davara at every darshini.

name: Brewolf
dex: It pours scalding steam from its shoulders. Darshini owners leave out a cup for it at closing time.
ref: Filter coffee, poured between a steel tumbler and davara at every darshini.

name: Kaapiraja
dex: Its steel crown is shaped like a coffee filter. Its roar smells of chicory and burnt sugar.
ref: Filter coffee, poured between a steel tumbler and davara at every darshini.

name: Elanee
dex: Its shell is a tender coconut. It sips lake water through its straw and sprays it at bullies.
ref: Tender coconut (elaneer) from the corner cart, and the stone steps of the old temple tanks.

name: Kobbari
dex: Its husky shell has become tough and fibrous. It guards the steps of old temple tanks.
ref: Tender coconut (elaneer) from the corner cart, and the stone steps of the old temple tanks.

name: Kerekurma
dex: Old stories say the city's lakes were dug by its footsteps. A small island grows on its back.
ref: Tender coconut (elaneer) from the corner cart, and the stone steps of the old temple tanks.

name: Gubbi
dex: Once seen on every balcony. It chirps loudest when someone puts out rice on a steel plate.
ref: House sparrows (gubbi) that once lived on every balcony; the kites that ride the city's warm air.

name: Haddu
dex: It circles over the city on warm air rising from the roads, then dives to snatch snacks from hands.
ref: House sparrows (gubbi) that once lived on every balcony; the kites that ride the city's warm air.

name: Hadduraja
dex: Its chestnut wings span a whole street. It nests on the tallest temple tower in town.
ref: House sparrows (gubbi) that once lived on every balcony; the kites that ride the city's warm air.

name: Alilu
dex: The three stripes on its back are said to be a blessing for helping build a bridge long ago.
ref: The three-striped palm squirrel (alilu); legend says it was stroked for helping build a bridge.

name: Alilord
dex: It rules its tree like a tiny king and defends it with a shield made from a peanut shell.
ref: The three-striped palm squirrel (alilu); legend says it was stroked for helping build a bridge.

name: Reshmite
dex: It eats only mulberry leaves. The thread it spins is softer than any machine-made silk.
ref: Karnataka silk: Ramanagara holds one of India's biggest silk-cocoon markets.

name: Koshoon
dex: It wraps itself in golden silk and dreams. Weavers wait patiently for it to wake.
ref: Karnataka silk: Ramanagara holds one of India's biggest silk-cocoon markets.

name: Reshmoth
dex: Its wings are patterned like a wedding saree. Its scales shimmer gold in lamplight.
ref: Karnataka silk: Ramanagara holds one of India's biggest silk-cocoon markets.

name: Sollu
dex: Swarms rise from still lake water at dusk. Its whine near your ear is impossible to ignore.
ref: The mosquitoes (sollu) of monsoon puddles.

name: Sollasura
dex: A tyrant of the monsoon. One bite and you'll scratch for a week.
ref: The mosquitoes (sollu) of monsoon puddles.

name: Hoge
dex: It is born from the exhaust of a thousand idling engines at red lights.
ref: Traffic smoke (hoge) at every junction.

name: Smogasura
dex: It hangs over the worst junctions at rush hour. Its rumble sounds like a thousand horns.
ref: Traffic smoke (hoge) at every junction.

name: Norepuff
dex: A clump of lake foam that came alive. Do not try to wash your hands in it.
ref: The toxic foam that drifts off Bellandur and Varthur lakes.

name: Noreyaksha
dex: It rises out of polluted lakes as a wall of foam. It only calms when the water is clean again.
ref: The toxic foam that drifts off Bellandur and Varthur lakes.
habitat: Rises out of the Bellandur foam once

name: Meenu
dex: It can do almost nothing except flop. Lake anglers throw it back out of pity.
ref: Fish of the city lakes; its evolution is drawn from temple naga carvings.

name: Meenaga
dex: No one believes a Meenu becomes this until they see it rise roaring from the lake.
ref: Fish of the city lakes; its evolution is drawn from temple naga carvings.

name: Bandekal
dex: It sits so still on hillsides that people paint signs on it.
ref: The granite boulders (bande kallu) of the Deccan plateau.

name: Bandeyodha
dex: Some say the old rocky hills around the city are sleeping Bandeyodha.
ref: The granite boulders (bande kallu) of the Deccan plateau.

name: Karu
dex: It wanders into traffic and simply stands there. Somehow every vehicle goes around it.
ref: Cattle on city roads and the painted bulls of Sankranti.

name: Hori
dex: At harvest festivals its horns are painted bright colors. Its charge can topple a bus.
ref: Cattle on city roads and the painted bulls of Sankranti.

name: Mangaa
dex: It ambushes tourists on hilltops and steals bananas, sunglasses and phones.
ref: The bonnet macaques of Nandi Hills, who steal tourists' snacks.

name: Kapikusti
dex: It trains in mud pits at dawn and challenges any wrestler who dares enter.
ref: The bonnet macaques of Nandi Hills, who steal tourists' snacks.

name: Bekku
dex: Every street has one. It knows exactly which house gives out milk.
ref: Street cats, and the black cat that crosses your path.

name: Kaalbekku
dex: If it crosses your path, people wait a moment before walking on. It finds this very funny.
ref: Street cats, and the black cat that crosses your path.

name: Goobe
dex: It stares at you all night from the banyan tree. Nobody knows what it is thinking.
ref: Spotted owlets (goobe) in old trees.

name: Goobeguru
dex: It tutors students in exam season. It is strict but never wrong.
ref: Spotted owlets (goobe) in old trees.

name: Neralu
dex: During power cuts it slips out of the shadows and plays with candle flames.
ref: Shadows (neralu) during the city's famous power cuts.

name: Neraluga
dex: It haunts the old palace corridors. Portraits' eyes seem to follow you when it is near.
ref: Shadows (neralu) during the city's famous power cuts.

name: Chintu
dex: It floats near people deep in thought, nibbling on stray ideas.
ref: Chintamani, the wish-granting jewel of legend.

name: Chintamani
dex: A wish-granting jewel in old tales. It only listens to wishes made for others.
ref: Chintamani, the wish-granting jewel of legend.

name: Aanemari
dex: It loves bath time in the river and sprays water at everyone nearby.
ref: Elephant calves of Bannerghatta and the golden howdah (ambaari) of the Dasara procession.

name: Ambaari
dex: It leads the grand autumn procession carrying a golden howdah. The crowds go silent as it passes.
ref: Elephant calves of Bannerghatta and the golden howdah (ambaari) of the Dasara procession.

name: Navilu
dex: It dances only when the first monsoon clouds roll in. Seeing it is said to bring rain.
ref: India's national bird, the peacock (navilu).

name: Haavu
dex: It hides in termite mounds and rock walls. It means no harm if left alone.
ref: Cobras and the naga stones under peepal trees.

name: Nagarahaavu
dex: When it raises its great hood, even the boldest Mangaa backs away.
ref: Cobras and the naga stones under peepal trees.

name: Kappe
dex: Its croaking chorus after the first rain keeps whole neighbourhoods awake.
ref: Frogs (kappe) that sing all night once the rain (male) starts.

name: Malekappe
dex: It summons a raincloud and rides the thunder. Flash floods follow its song.
ref: Frogs (kappe) that sing all night once the rain (male) starts.

name: Volti
dex: When it gets excited the whole street's lights flicker. Then the power goes out.
ref: Transformers, tangled cables and power cuts.

name: Currentaa
dex: "Current hogide!" is the cry when it feeds on a transformer. It is always gone before the linemen arrive.
ref: Transformers, tangled cables and power cuts.

name: Chiplet
dex: It lives inside office laptops and gets cranky after midnight deploys.
ref: Bengaluru, the 'Silicon Valley of India'.

name: Siliconda
dex: It coils through the server rooms of tech parks. Its hiss sounds like a cooling fan.
ref: Bengaluru, the 'Silicon Valley of India'.

name: Autorikshasa
dex: It never goes where you ask. It always asks for one-and-a-half over the meter.
ref: The auto-rickshaw. 'Meter haaki, saar!'

name: Halasu
dex: Its spiky skin hides a sweet smell. Squirrels follow it everywhere.
ref: Jackfruit (halasu), sold in heaps every summer.

name: Halasuru
dex: So heavy that it leaves potholes. The city has stopped trying to fix them.
ref: Jackfruit (halasu), sold in heaps every summer.

name: Gulmo
dex: It blooms bright red in the hottest week of summer.
ref: Gulmohar trees blazing red in May.

name: Gulmohara
dex: Its flowers look like flames, and in May they really are.
ref: Gulmohar trees blazing red in May.

name: Railu
dex: It runs back and forth along the same track all day and never gets bored.
ref: Namma Metro and its purple and green lines.

name: Metrovaha
dex: It carries thousands across the city every day and is never on time, except when you are late.
ref: Namma Metro and its purple and green lines.

name: Chinnu
dex: It sparkles in old mine shafts east of the city. Prospectors once followed it for luck.
ref: The Kolar Gold Fields east of the city.

name: Chinnasura
dex: Its body is veined with gold. It guards abandoned mines and hates trespassers.
ref: The Kolar Gold Fields east of the city.

name: Hulimari
dex: It pounces at drumbeats and dances until it tires out.
ref: Huli vesha, the tiger dance of Karnataka festivals.

name: Hulivesha
dex: It leads the tiger dance at festivals. Its stomp shakes the whole street.
ref: Huli vesha, the tiger dance of Karnataka festivals.

name: Hanate
dex: A lamp that was never blown out. It lights the way for lost children.
ref: The clay oil lamps (hanate) of Deepavali.

name: Jyotiyaksha
dex: On festival nights it gathers every lamp in the city into a single robe of light.
ref: The clay oil lamps (hanate) of Deepavali.

name: Udyanaga
dex: Guardian of the Garden City. When the city forgets its trees and lakes, it sleeps atop the northern hills.
ref: The Garden City itself: Lalbagh, Cubbon Park and the city's lost lakes.
habitat: Nandi Hills summit, after the Syndicate is beaten

name: Concretor
dex: Built by the Concrete Syndicate from cement mixers and cranes. Wherever it walks, grass stops growing.
ref: The concrete jungle that keeps eating the Garden City.

name: Naayimari
dex: Every street has one. It follows whoever last fed it biscuits, which is everyone.
ref: Bengaluru's famous street dogs, fed by every darshini and guarded by every aunty.

name: Beedinaayi
dex: It knows every shortcut in the neighbourhood and barks only at strangers on motorbikes.
ref: Bengaluru's famous street dogs, fed by every darshini and guarded by every aunty.

name: Kaavalnaayi
dex: The leader of the night pack. Shopkeepers sleep well when it patrols their lane.
ref: Bengaluru's famous street dogs, fed by every darshini and guarded by every aunty.

name: Gedalu
dex: It chews dry wood and spits out red mud. Empty plots fill with its tiny towers overnight.
ref: The red-earth termite mounds (huttu) of the city's empty plots, sacred in naga lore.

name: Huttuhula
dex: It lives inside a mound of hardened red clay and wears part of it as armour.
ref: The red-earth termite mounds (huttu) of the city's empty plots, sacred in naga lore.

name: Huttappa
dex: A walking termite mound as tall as a house. Its chimneys hum when it is about to charge.
ref: The red-earth termite mounds (huttu) of the city's empty plots, sacred in naga lore.

name: Kadale
dex: It buries itself in sandy soil and pops up when someone shells peanuts nearby.
ref: Basavanagudi's Kadalekai Parishe, the groundnut fair right next to the home town.

name: Kadalekaayi
dex: At the groundnut fair it is guest of honour. Its roots grow pods it shares with kids.
ref: Basavanagudi's Kadalekai Parishe, the groundnut fair right next to the home town.

name: Idlimari
dex: Soft and warm, it bounces when happy. Darshini cooks swear it once escaped the steamer.
ref: Breakfast at every darshini.

name: Thatteidli
dex: A stack of idlis on a steel plate. Wherever it rests, people feel like it's breakfast time.
ref: Breakfast at every darshini.

name: Halli
dex: It clings to the wall above the tube light. Grandmothers listen when it chirps.
ref: Halli shastra: a lizard chirping or falling on you is read as an omen.

name: Hallishastri
dex: It reads the future in the chirps of other lizards and is right just often enough.
ref: Halli shastra: a lizard chirping or falling on you is read as an omen.

name: Kulfimari
dex: It lives in the clay pot of the kulfi cart and only comes out on the hottest afternoons.
ref: Ice-cream carts, Corner House and the Gadbad sundae.

name: Gadbadu
dex: A towering sundae of every flavour. Children follow it in parades all summer.
ref: Ice-cream carts, Corner House and the Gadbad sundae.

name: Bennedose
dex: A golden butter dosa that flies like a carpet and leaves a trail of ghee sparks.
ref: Benne dose from Davangere; the dosa institutions around Lalbagh.

name: Taavaremari
dex: A lotus bud riding a lily pad. It drifts to the warmest corner of the lake to bloom.
ref: Lotuses in Lalbagh lake and the old temple tanks.

name: Taavare
dex: When it opens its petals at dawn, the whole lake goes still to watch.
ref: Lotuses in Lalbagh lake and the old temple tanks.

name: Istri
dex: A heavy charcoal iron box. It presses any cloth flat, whether you want it to or not.
ref: The istri-wala's pushcart on every residential street.

name: Istriraaja
dex: It rules the ironing cart at the street corner, coals blazing, every shirt perfectly pressed.
ref: The istri-wala's pushcart on every residential street.

name: Jenuhula
dex: Rock bees build hives the size of doors under the ledges of the Assembly building.
ref: The huge rock-bee hives hanging from Vidhana Soudha and the Cubbon Park trees.

name: Jenuraani
dex: The queen of a hive of thousands. Her honey is said to cure sore throats and bad moods.
ref: The huge rock-bee hives hanging from Vidhana Soudha and the Cubbon Park trees.

name: Minchuhula
dex: Its tail blinks in patterns. Researchers think it is gossiping with other fireflies.
ref: Fireflies along the city's last dark lake edges.

name: Minchurani
dex: On dark nights hundreds gather around it and the lake shore lights up like a festival.
ref: Fireflies along the city's last dark lake edges.

name: Mungusi
dex: Quick and fearless. It boxes snakes for practice and usually wins.
ref: Mongooses in the scrub around the city, fearless against snakes.

name: Mungusiveera
dex: A scarred champion. The cobras of the scrubland give it a very wide berth.
ref: Mongooses in the scrub around the city, fearless against snakes.

name: Baavali
dex: It hangs upside down in the park's old trees all day and raids mango trees all night.
ref: The flying-fox colony roosting in Cubbon Park's old trees.

name: Baavalasura
dex: Its wings blot out the street lamps. Gardeners blame it for every missing fruit.
ref: The flying-fox colony roosting in Cubbon Park's old trees.

name: Pataaki
dex: A strip of tiny crackers. It giggles, sparks and pops when anyone steps on it.
ref: Deepavali nights, when every street sounds like a battlefield.

name: Sutli
dex: Wrapped tight in jute string. Its bang can be heard three neighbourhoods away.
ref: Deepavali nights, when every street sounds like a battlefield.

name: Rocketaaki
dex: It launches into the night sky and bursts into colours before landing gracefully again.
ref: Deepavali nights, when every street sounds like a battlefield.

name: Gundi
dex: A pothole that wanders. It fills with rainwater and waits for someone's scooter.
ref: Bengaluru potholes, a civic institution.

name: Mahagundi
dex: So deep it has its own echo. Road crews fill it every year, and every year it comes back.
ref: Bengaluru potholes, a civic institution.

name: Heggana
dex: A bandicoot of the storm drains. It is bigger than a cat and braver than a dog.
ref: The giant bandicoots of the city's storm drains.

name: Hegganasura
dex: The king of the drains. It comes up when it rains and drags away anything left outside.
ref: The giant bandicoots of the city's storm drains.

name: Signalu
dex: A traffic signal that wandered off. It turns red whenever you are in a hurry.
ref: Silk Board junction, where signals last long enough to evolve.

name: Signalappa
dex: It runs an entire junction. Its red light lasts long enough for drivers to finish a phone call.
ref: Silk Board junction, where signals last long enough to evolve.

name: Kasa
dex: A heap of unsorted rubbish that walks. It grows every time someone skips segregation day.
ref: The city's garbage crisis and the dream of segregated waste.

name: Kasaraashi
dex: It hides in empty plots and grabs passing garbage trucks to make itself bigger.
ref: The city's garbage crisis and the dream of segregated waste.

name: Thandi
dex: A runaway air conditioner. It blasts cold air at anyone who complains about the heat.
ref: Whitefield tech parks kept at 18°C while it's 34°C outside.

name: Thandasura
dex: It lives on tech-park rooftops and keeps whole buildings at 18 degrees.
ref: Whitefield tech parks kept at 18°C while it's 34°C outside.

name: Midathe
dex: A grasshopper that plays gully cricket. It uses its hind legs as bats and never gets out.
ref: Cricket, the insect and the sport; gully cricket in every lane.

name: Mahamidathe
dex: Its sixes clear the stadium roof. Opposing bowlers bring it gifts before matches.
ref: Cricket, the insect and the sport; gully cricket in every lane.

name: Benkinore
dex: Lake foam that caught fire one day and never went out.
ref: The real day Bellandur Lake caught fire.

name: Kerebenki
dex: A burning cloud that rises off polluted water. Its smoke spells out warnings to the city.
ref: The real day Bellandur Lake caught fire.

name: Edi
dex: A lake crab with one big claw. It shadow-boxes the reeds at dawn.
ref: The freshwater crabs of Bengaluru's lakes.

name: Ediyodha
dex: It guards the lake steps with two huge claws and has never lost a pinching match.
ref: The freshwater crabs of Bengaluru's lakes.

name: Mallige
dex: A jasmine bud with a sweet scent. Flower sellers string it into garlands without noticing.
ref: Malleshwaram's flower sellers and the GI-tagged Mysore mallige.

name: Mysoremallige
dex: It wears a garland of a thousand blooms. Its scent can calm a traffic jam.
ref: Malleshwaram's flower sellers and the GI-tagged Mysore mallige.

name: Chukki
dex: A grid of white dots that rearranges itself into patterns on doorsteps before sunrise.
ref: Morning rangoli outside Malleshwaram homes.

name: Rangavalli
dex: A full rangoli come to life. Every festival it chooses new colours.
ref: Morning rangoli outside Malleshwaram homes.

name: Gombe
dex: A lacquered wooden toy that rolls on its own. It sulks if put away after the festival.
ref: Channapatna toys and the Dasara bombe habba doll steps.

name: Pattadagombe
dex: The royal doll couple from the top step of the festival display. It remembers every family it has visited.
ref: Channapatna toys and the Dasara bombe habba doll steps.

name: Togalu
dex: A leather puppet that moves when the lamp is lit. It acts out old stories on any wall.
ref: Togalu gombeyata, Karnataka's leather shadow-puppet theatre.

name: Togalugombe
dex: Its shadow can be a king, a tiger or a storm. It never shows its true shape.
ref: Togalu gombeyata, Karnataka's leather shadow-puppet theatre.

name: Kaage
dex: Families leave rice out for it on remembrance days. It carries the offering to the ancestors.
ref: Crows are fed rice for the ancestors during Pitru Paksha.

name: Kaageraaja
dex: The crow king who walks between this world and the next with messages for the living.
ref: Crows are fed rice for the ancestors during Pitru Paksha.

name: Hunase
dex: A tamarind sapling hung with sour pods. Children dare each other to pick them at night.
ref: Village lore says ghosts live in tamarind trees.

name: Hunasemohini
dex: Village tales say a spirit lives in every old tamarind tree. This is the spirit.
ref: Village lore says ghosts live in tamarind trees.

name: Gandhamari
dex: A sandalwood sapling. Its fragrance makes nearby creatures sleepy and kind.
ref: Karnataka's sandalwood (and 'Sandalwood', the nickname of Kannada cinema).

name: Shrigandha
dex: Its heartwood is so fragrant that a single branch scents a whole palace for a year.
ref: Karnataka's sandalwood (and 'Sandalwood', the nickname of Kannada cinema).

name: Kokkare
dex: A pelican chick from the nesting village. Its pouch is always full of tiny fish.
ref: Kokkare Bellur, the village near Bengaluru where pelicans and painted storks nest on rooftops.

name: Bannadakokkare
dex: A painted stork with rose-pink wings. Villagers count its return each winter as good luck.
ref: Kokkare Bellur, the village near Bengaluru where pelicans and painted storks nest on rooftops.

name: Tagaru
dex: A young ram that headbutts everything. Its horns are painted for the fair.
ref: Tagaru kaalaga, the ram fights of village fairs on the city's outskirts.

name: Kaadutagaru
dex: A fighting ram of the hills. When it charges, the ground cracks under its hooves.
ref: Tagaru kaalaga, the ram fights of village fairs on the city's outskirts.

name: Aalikallu
dex: A hailstone that grew a face during a summer storm. It is surprised every time it doesn't melt.
ref: Bengaluru's sudden April hailstorms.

name: Aalibande
dex: A boulder of ice and granite. It rolls down the hills during freak hailstorms.
ref: Bengaluru's sudden April hailstorms.

name: Manju
dex: A wisp of morning fog. Travellers on the hill road lose their way when it giggles.
ref: Nandi Hills sunrise above the clouds.

name: Manjumaaye
dex: It wraps the whole hill in fog at sunrise and reveals the view only to those it likes.
ref: Nandi Hills sunrise above the clouds.

name: Chiratemari
dex: A leopard cub that hides in rocky scrub. It practises stalking on lizards.
ref: Leopards still roam Bannerghatta and Turahalli at the city's edge.

name: Chirate
dex: It slips through the forest edge at night without a sound. Only its eyes give it away.
ref: Leopards still roam Bannerghatta and Turahalli at the city's edge.

name: Kaadupaapa
dex: The 'forest baby'. It moves so slowly that few have seen it, but its huge eyes see everything.
ref: 'Kaadu paapa' (forest baby), the endangered slender loris of the Bengaluru region.

name: Makaramari
dex: A young temple-arch beast hiding in the old tanks. Fishermen think it is a crocodile with a trunk.
ref: The Makara torana arch over temple doorways; Sankey and Hebbal were once temple tanks.

name: Makara
dex: The beast carved over temple doors. When it surfaces, the tank's water rises to the top step.
ref: The Makara torana arch over temple doorways; Sankey and Hebbal were once temple tanks.

name: Paachikallu
dex: Revived from three-billion-year-old rock. It is the oldest kind of life ever found in the city.
ref: Lalbagh's rock is about 3,000 million years old, among the oldest on Earth.
habitat: Revived from the Old Moss Stone (Nandi Cave)

name: Paachibande
dex: Its layered body is a record of the planet's first sunrises.
ref: Lalbagh's rock is about 3,000 million years old, among the oldest on Earth.

name: Kalluhula
dex: Revived from a fossil in the cave. It rolls into a stone ball when startled.
ref: Same ancient Lalbagh rock; the other fossil choice.
habitat: Revived from the Old Shell Stone (Nandi Cave)

name: Kalluveera
dex: An ancient armoured hunter. Its shell is harder than the granite it was found in.
ref: Same ancient Lalbagh rock; the other fossil choice.

name: Yalimari
dex: A temple-pillar cub that shook itself loose from the stone. It still has chisel marks on its paws.
ref: Yali pillars line Vijayanagara-era temples across Karnataka.

name: Yalikamba
dex: It guards a ruined mandapa and rears up on its hind legs like the carvings it came from.
ref: Yali pillars line Vijayanagara-era temples across Karnataka.

name: Mahayali
dex: The great guardian of every temple gate. Legends say a whole hall of pillars came alive to form it.
ref: Yali pillars line Vijayanagara-era temples across Karnataka.

name: Gandaberunda
dex: The two-headed eagle of the old kingdom's seal. It wakes only when the land needs a protector.
ref: Gandaberunda is on the state seal above Vidhana Soudha's doors.

name: Bisilu
dex: The spirit of summer. In April it lies on the granite hills and the rocks glow with heat.
ref: April on the Deccan plateau; the bare granite hills of Ramanagara.

name: Mungaru
dex: The spirit of the monsoon. Its trumpet is the first thunder of June.
ref: Mungaru male, the southwest monsoon; old poems call rain clouds elephants.
habitat: Hebbal lake shore, after becoming Champion

name: Chali
dex: The spirit of winter mornings. It is seen only at sunrise, gliding over the sea of clouds.
ref: December fog at Nandi Hills; the hornbills of the Western Ghats.
habitat: Nandi Hills sunrise point, after becoming Champion

name: Bendakaalu
dex: The boiled bean of the old legend, said to have fed a lost king. The city is named after it.
ref: The legend of 'Benda Kaalu Ooru', the town of boiled beans that became Bengaluru.
habitat: The groundnut fair in Basavanagudi, after meeting the other legends
